statement: Build a one-file website for CityCare Hospital in Bengaluru where patients can send a visit request, find emergency information, read doctor profiles and a health blog, and use all of it in English, Kannada and Hindi.
audience: Patients and their families in Bengaluru, reading in English, Kannada or Hindi.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step; CDN libraries allowed.
Emergency and booking wording is short and plain in every language.
Every placeholder or unverified item is visibly marked on the page.
Kannada and Hindi text is a full translation, labelled 'pending native review'.
rules: The booking form is a visit request. No text may say or imply the visit is confirmed.
The emergency number must be a visibly marked placeholder, never a realistic-looking phone number.
Sample doctors and sample articles must be labelled as samples and must not present invented people or medical claims as real.
Booking and emergency content must not depend on live hospital systems.
done_when: The site is a single HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inline or loaded from a CDN, and it needs no build step.
A language switch offers English, Kannada and Hindi, and every section (booking, emergency, doctors, blog) has text in all three.
The booking section has a request form (name, phone, preferred date, department or doctor, reason), and visible text in all three languages states it is a request, not a confirmed booking.
An emergency section is reachable from the top of the page in every language and shows a marked placeholder number, which is not a realistic phone number, and a marked placeholder address.
A doctor profiles section shows more than one profile, each labelled as a sample, in all three languages.
A health blog section shows more than one article, each labelled as a sample, in all three languages.
Kannada and Hindi content carries a visible 'pending native review' label.
Every placeholder in the file (emergency number, address, contact details, doctors, articles) is visibly marked as a placeholder.
open_inputs: Real emergency number(s) and hospital address (replace the marked placeholders).
Hospital contact details for visit-request confirmation messages.
A third-party form or message service to deliver requests and confirmation messages.
Real blog topics and articles, with medical review before publishing.
Native Kannada and Hindi reviewers to confirm the translations, especially emergency and booking wording.
